section.label: Experience & Learning
section.title: Trajectory
section.introText: A non-exhaustive index of where the work has come from and where it is currently heading. Emphasis on direction rather than accomplishment.

entries.title: Headless Low-Code Web Application Builder
entries.description: Investigating abstraction layers and headless architecture for low-code web application builders. Architecture mapping and literature review phase.

entries.title: React & Modern Web Interfaces
entries.description: Building web applications and interfaces with React and Vite. Focused on accessible UI implementation and design-to-code fidelity.

entries.title: Laravel & PHP
entries.description: Building full-stack web applications with Laravel and PHP. Practical experience with routing, Eloquent, authentication, and structured backend implementation.

entries.title: Visual Identity & Artwork
entries.description: Ongoing graphic design practice — album covers, posters, social media design. Building visual literacy alongside development work.

entries.title: Programming & Web Fundamentals
entries.description: Building foundational understanding of web technologies, programming patterns, and the relationship between front-end and back-end systems.
